options.text: Achievement.
Achievement.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Christianity Founded

options.text: Encourage the disciples to preach openly.
Instruct them to preach in private.
Ban the disciples from preaching.

events.text: The death of a man named Jesus Christ has sparked the worship of [religion] in [city]. A group of men calling themselves the Disciples of the Lord have been preaching in the city, telling stories of Jesus as the son of God. Separating from their Jewish origins, the newly dubbed [religion] encourage pious dedication to their god. Will you support this new religion?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Christianity Founded

options.text: We will help [religion] to grow.
The followers of [religion] have our support.

events.text: [religion] holds sway in [rival], but it is no longer uncontested. A new branch of Judaism has been rapidly gaining popularity in [city], offering a route to salvation through their messiah, Jesus Christ. What started as small gatherings on the streets and near the temples has rapidly organized and grown into its own religion. Your advisors come to you with a warning. A second religion has the potential to create divisions within the court. However, building up [religion] could bring further culture and wisdom to [rival]. Will you encourage this new religion?

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Followers Gather

options.text: Allow them to gather.
Ensure the new arrivals do not remain for long.

events.text: As word spreads, believers now throng through the streets of [city], with more arriving every day.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Judaism Founded

options.text: Invite their leaders to the court.
Ask for a copy of their laws.
This does not concern me.

events.text: The descendants of the prophet Abraham have settled in the city of [city], bringing [religion] into the world. The [religion] believers worship God through sacrifice and the reading of their sacred texts, given by God to the prophet Moses. Their dedication is such that they won't pray to any other gods and strictly follow the laws set out by their religious creed. Will you support this new religion?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Judaism Founded

options.text: We will help [religion] to grow.
The followers of [religion] have our support.

events.text: [religion] holds sway in [rival], but it is no longer uncontested. [religion] has emerged in [city], where the faithful gather regularly to read and study the laws laid down by their prophets. They believe in a single God, who they worship through both temple sacrifice and personal piety. Your advisors come to you with a warning. A second religion has the potential to create divisions within the court. However, building up [religion] could bring further culture and wisdom to [rival]. Will you encourage this new religion?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Manichaeism Founded

options.text: Invite their leaders to meet your scholars.
Ask to hear more of their ideas.
We have nothing to learn from you.

events.text: The people of [city] have started the Religion of Light, [religion]. Revering Mani as the final prophet after the Buddha, Jesus, and Zoroaster, the followers of [religion] view the world as under the influence of both the good powers of God and the evil of the Devil. They seek out spiritual knowledge in this flawed world. Will you support this new religion?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Manichaeism Founded

options.text: We will help [religion] to grow.
The followers of [religion] have our support.

events.text: [religion] holds sway in [rival], but it is no longer uncontested. The spread of Zoroastrianism and Christianity has seen the birth of a new religion. Following the teachings of the prophet Mani, the followers of this Religion of Light believe that he builds on the ideas of the older religions and seek truth in the duality of the pure world of thought and the material world of sin. Your advisors come to you with a warning. A second religion has the potential to create divisions within the court. However, building up [religion] could bring further culture and wisdom to [rival]. Will you encourage this new religion?

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Mother of the Faith

options.text: Practitioners of this new Faith should work to enhance and expand the cultural influence of our nation.
The Priests and Priestesses should work to instill a greater sense of civic duty among the faithful.

events.text: As a Priestess of the God of the Moon, you have worked tirelessly to plant the seeds of religion throughout your realm. With the founding of a formal religion, those plans have come to full flower at last. As the Mother of this new faith, you now have an opportunity to put your imprint on it and provide some guidance as to its shape, form, and ultimate purpose.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Church of Mani

options.text: Welcome [character], and his teachings, into your court.
Spend days discussing his beliefs and divine gnosis.
Send away this charlatan and fraud.

events.text: You have heard of a prophet in [city], preaching a new religion known as the religion of light, [religion]. [character] is said to have heard the voice of his heavenly twin as a child, leaving his father's parish to travel the world. He has now returned, bringing a new knowledge of the divine order and structure of the world. The court wish to know how you will react to this new religion.

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Tutorial: Paganism

options.text: I'll build more Shrine if I want to spread Paganism!

events.text: Pagan Religion are founded by building your first Shrine, and they spread by building more Shrine. They have no Disciple, Theology, or access to special Religious Improvement, but improving the Religion's Opinion Religion will increase Happiness in Cities with the Religion. Paganism can be adopted as a State Religion if you enact Divine Rule.

events.author: Solver
events.name: Zoroastrianism Founded

options.text: We need to understand the nature of all creation.
Divine inspiration can teach us to think good thoughts and do good deeds.
As the forces of truth oppose the forces of lies, they teach us how to confront our enemies.
Diligent study and performance of rituals will reveal to us what we must know.

events.text: A completely new teaching originates in [city]. The faithful call it [religion]. It is a fascinating set of beliefs unlike any of those earlier present in [rival]. The new religion teaches that the omniscient, eternal Ahura Mazda created all there is. Elaborate worship rituals involve fire and water, primordial elements the faithful believe to have played a clear role in creation itself. As this new religion establishes itself, you have the opportunity to discuss its teachings with the [religion] leaders. What do you think the most important thing to learn is?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Zoroastrianism Founded

options.text: Offer stone to build places of worship.
Ask to learn more about their ways.
What the people believe is their concern.

events.text: Born from the ancient fire cults, [religion] has taken hold in [city]. The teachings of the prophet Zoroaster have been passed down from generation to generation and are now becoming a regular part of life in the city. They describe a cosmic struggle, the divine Ahura Mazda fighting against the chaotic Angra Mainyu. Those who live with the ideals of truth, justice and humility give aid to Ahura Mazda in his fight. Will you support this new religion?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Zoroastrianism Founded

options.text: We will help [religion] to grow.
The followers of [religion] have our support.

events.text: [religion] holds sway in [rival], but it is no longer uncontested. With the increased role and organization of acolytes within your nation, their pagan ways have evolved into a new religion altogether in [city]. The worshippers of [religion] claim that they support the god Ahura Mazda as he fights to bring the world to perfection. Your advisors come to you with a warning. A second religion has the potential to create divisions within the court. However, building up [religion] could bring further culture and wisdom to [rival]. Will you encourage this new religion?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [religion] Founded

options.text: Gift food to help support the growing community of disciples.
Their self discipline is inspiring.
Excellent, more people to tax.

events.text: <p.is_sub.S2=SUBJECT_PLAYER_MAURYA>In recent years, there has been a growing following in [city] of the teachings left by the enlightened teacher known as the Buddha.<else>Merchants have arrived in [city] bringing the ancient religion of [religion] from a distant land.<end> The Buddha’s disciples now spread his teachings, encouraging believers to see enlightenment through a middle path between indulgence and asceticism. Only this path, they say, can allow one to escape from the endless cycle of death and rebirth, of suffering and attachment. Open to followers of any caste or clan, [religion] is quickly capturing the hearts and minds of many. Will you support this new religion?
